B Cess and Other Taxes on Minerals (Validation) Act, 1992: Sections 2(1), 2(2) and 2(3)-Nature and scope of-Held, validated only levy and collection of cess and other taxes imposed under the invalid C state laws-But did not confer any right on state to levy, demand or collect fresh cess provisions of Article 265 as it would amount to imposing a tax without any authority of law-Duration of Validation Act being only for a specified period and there being no saving clause, it is in the nature of D temporary statute-Section 2(3) only provides a limited saving clause for
